title: Fresh Session Real Tuple Readonly Sequencer
claim: A fresh ChatGPT session can call the read-only guarded sequencer with the real FP-MCP-295 request tuple and receive RECORD_APPROVAL without host blocking.
summary: Record that the real execution packet id, request id, execution base commit, model id, and run mode did not trigger a host block when used in the read-only sequencer from a fresh session with a synthetic approval id.
caveats: This did not call guarded apply.
This did not contact the runner start endpoint.
observedResult: A fresh ChatGPT session can call the read-only guarded sequencer with the real FP-MCP-295 request tuple and receive RECORD_APPROVAL without host blocking.
